Style: hyperrealistic commercial-photography look with crisp 8K clarity, bright cool-white office lighting, and a clean modern boardroom environment. A young East Asian female business presenter stands confidently beside a large projection screen, wearing a fitted matte white commuter blazer and matching trousers. She has fair skin with realistic delicate texture, refined light makeup, subtle eyeliner, natural blush, soft red lipstick, and black hair styled in a neat low bun with loose strands near the face. Her posture is upright and professional; she faces the seated audience in side profile, her mouth slightly open as if explaining, and her right hand naturally raised with the index finger extended toward the projected technical slide. Her expression is calm, focused, composed, and confident, suggesting she is delivering a polished corporate or engineering presentation. Around her, several attendees are partially visible in the foreground and background, softly out of focus: people sit at a long conference table facing the screen, including a person in a dark shirt on the left, blurred figures near the center and right, and partial profiles at the lower right edge. On the wooden meeting table there is an open silver laptop, a dark cup and saucer, eyeglasses, papers or notebooks, a smartphone-like device, and other small office items arranged casually but neatly. The room features glass partition walls, pale gray surfaces, warm vertical wood trim, and linear ceiling LED lights, creating a clean, high-end business training atmosphere.

The large projected screen dominates the right side of the image, framed by a thin black border with small mounting brackets at the top corners. The slide uses a white background, dark navy-blue sans-serif typography, fine gray dividers, rectangular section frames, bullet lists, mathematical notation, and a process diagram. The woman’s extended finger points directly toward the “扩散模型原理” section around the formula area, visually emphasizing the technical explanation. Full body text as follows: "扩散模型核心技术讲解"
"Diffusion Model Core Technology Presentation"
"一、扩散模型概述（Overview）"
扩散模型（Diffusion Probabilistic Model）是一种基于逐步去噪过程的生成模型，通过学习数据分布的逆转扩散过程，从纯噪声中生成高质量样本。其核心思想是：在前向过程中逐步加入高斯噪声破坏数据，在反向过程中逐步去除噪声以重建原始数据。"
"1.1 核心定义"
设数据为 x_0 ~ q_data(x)，前向加噪过程为 q(x_t|x_0)=N(x_t;√(1−β_t)x_0，β_tI)，其中 β_t ∈ (0,1] 为噪声调度系数；"
"反向去噪过程为 p_θ(x_{t−1}|x_t)=N(x_{t−1};μ_θ(x_t,t),Σ_θ(x_t,t))，参数化为神经网络预测。"
"二、前向扩散过程（Forward Diffusion Process）"
前向过程固定，按预设调度逐步添加高斯噪声，将真实数据逐渐转化为标准高斯噪声。"
"2.1 过程定义"
"q(x_t|x_0)=N(x_t;√(1−ᾱ_t)x_0，ᾱ_tI)"
"其中 ᾱ_t = Π_{s=1}^t α_s，α_t = 1 − β_t，β_t 为噪声调度。"
"2.2 关键性质"
任意时刻 x_t 仅与 x_0 有关： q(x_t|x_0)=N(x_t;√(1−ᾱ_t)x_0，ᾱ_tI)；"
"马尔可夫性成立： q(x_t|x_0)=∫q(x_t|x_{t−1})q(x_{t−1}|x_0)dx_{t−1}"
"三、反向去噪过程（Reverse Denoising Process）"
反向过程是可学习的，神经网络用于估计去噪方向，从而逐步恢复数据。"
"3.1 模型参数化"
"p_θ(x_{t−1}|x_t)=N(x_{t−1};μ_θ(x_t,t),Σ_θ(x_t,t))"
"常见简化为方差固定： Σ_θ(x_t,t)=σ_t^2I"
"3.2 最优参数解（理论最优）"
"μ_θ^*(x_t,t)=1/√ᾱ_t( x_t − β_t/√(1−ᾱ_t) ε_θ( x_t/√ᾱ_t,t ))"
"其中 ε_θ(·,t) 为神经网络预测的噪声，通常使用 U-Net 实现。"
"四、训练目标（Training Objective）"
通过最小化预测噪声与实际噪声的差异来训练模型。"
"4.1 损失函数（DDPM 目标）"
ℒ = E_{t∼U{1…T},ε∼N(0,I)} ||ε − ε_θ(√ᾱ_t x_0 + √(1−ᾱ_t)ε,t)||_2^2"
"等价形式（速度预测）："
"ℒ_v = E_{t,ε,v} ||v − v_θ(√ᾱ_t x_0 + √(1−ᾱ_t)ε,t)||_2^2， v=(1−ᾱ_t)/√(1−ᾱ_t) ε"
"五、扩散模型工作流程（Workflow）"
"数据准备：收集数据集 D = {x_i}，i=1…N，进行归一化处理。"
"前向加噪：对每张图像 x_0 按调度逐步加噪得到 T 步高斯噪声 x_T。"
"模型训练：最小化上述损失函数，使网络学会预测噪声或去噪方向。"
"反向采样：从随机噪声 x_T 开始，根据 p_θ 逐步去噪得到 x_0。"
"输出结果：生成高质量样本图像。"
A small legend box on the lower-right portion of the slide defines symbols in compact dark text: "符号说明："
"x_t： t 时刻的数据分布"
"β_t：噪声调度系数"
"ᾱ_t：累计噪声系数"
"μ_θ,Σ_θ：反向过程均值与方差"
"ε_θ：噪声预测网络"
At the bottom-left margin of the projected slide, a small blue page indicator reads "7 / 20". The overall slide design is technical, academic, and presentation-oriented, using dark blue headings, smaller black body text, thin gray rounded rectangles, and mathematical formulas to explain diffusion models clearly. The projected image is sharp and bright without heavy glare, allowing the text to remain legible while the presenter’s gesture draws attention to the core principle section. The entire scene reads as a polished business or technical training presentation about diffusion model core technology.
